title: Apple's 2026 Pivot: New CEO, Google AI, and LG Hardware
alt_titles: Why Apple Just Partnered With Google and LG
Apple Under John Ternus: The Real Strategy
description:
Tim Cook has stepped down, John Ternus is in charge, and Apple is partnering with Google and LG to accelerate its AI and smart home hardware roadmap. Here is the full breakdown of Apple's biggest strategic pivot in fifteen years.

Sources:
https://blockonomi.com/apple-inc-aapl-stock-climbs-as-lg-partnership-expands-ai-powered-home-devices/
https://www.cnbc.com/2026/06/08/apple-wwdc-2026-live-updates.html
https://www.insidermonkey.com/news/apple-aapl-can-longer-iphone-ownership-still-produce-more-profit-per-customer-1854608/
https://www.apple.com/newsroom/2026/07/apple-to-increase-spend-with-broadcom-to-produce-billions-more-us-chips/
https://www.macobserver.com/news/lopez-v-apple-inc-settlement-siri-users-start-receiving-payments/

scenes.narration: Tim Cook has officially stepped down as Apple CEO, and Apple is suddenly letting Google and LG power core pieces of its ecosystem. This is the single biggest identity shift in Cupertino in fifteen years.
scenes.heading: The End of an Era
scenes.subheading: Tim Cook steps down as CEO

scenes.narration: By the end of this video, you will know whether Apple's new AI architecture and smart home line actually justify its massive 36 times earnings multiple.
scenes.heading: Forward Price to Earnings

scenes.narration: Tim Cook delivered his final WWDC address in June, formally passing the CEO title to hardware engineering lead John Ternus in September. Ternus takes over right as Apple scrambles to catch up in agentic AI.
scenes.heading: Apple Executive Transition
scenes.subheading: Hardware chief John Ternus takes over

scenes.narration: The frontline of that fight is Siri AI. It is a completely redesigned assistant with a standalone app, long conversational recall, screen context awareness on Mac, and autonomous agents in the Passwords app.
scenes.heading: Siri AI Overhaul

scenes.narration: Instead of building frontier models strictly in-house, Apple partnered with Google. Lightweight queries process on your device, while heavy tasks route to AFM Cloud Pro, running on Nvidia GPUs inside Google Cloud.
scenes.heading: How Siri AI Thinks

scenes.narration: There is a massive catch. Siri AI requires Apple's latest hardware silicon to run. And due to fierce regulatory barriers, Apple had to exclude both Europe and China from the rollout.
scenes.heading: Siri AI Launch Limits

scenes.narration: If you're waiting for rumored hardware like an iPhone Duo, don't hold your breath. Apple hasn't announced any dual-screen device, relying instead on its existing lineup—where iPhone revenue already jumped 22 percent—to push people onto new silicon.
scenes.heading: Quarterly iPhone Revenue

scenes.narration: Then comes Apple's new Home Collection. Rather than building hardware alone, Apple teamed up with LG and Schneider Electric to ship connected cameras, doorbells, and Ultra Wideband smart locks this December.
scenes.heading: Apple Home Collection

scenes.narration: Setup takes a single tap with your iPhone. The gear streams up to two point five K resolution with on-device detection, local storage fallback during outages, and ten days of encrypted video search on iCloud Plus.
scenes.broll_query: person holding phone near front door
scenes.heading: Smart Home Architecture

scenes.narration: To guarantee its domestic supply chain, Apple also signed a multiyear deal with Broadcom exceeding thirty billion dollars to build fifteen billion custom chips and filters in Fort Collins, Colorado.
scenes.heading: Thirty Billion Dollar Deal

scenes.narration: Services brought in thirty point seven billion dollars last quarter at seventy-six percent gross margins. But quarterly research and development spending jumped by two point nine billion, actually outpacing the Services unit's gross profit gains.
scenes.heading: R and D Outpacing Gains

scenes.narration: That spending pressure makes Apple's valuation noticeable. Apple trades at thirty-six times forward earnings, compared to hardware rivals like Samsung at just five times forward earnings.
scenes.heading: The Valuation Gap

scenes.narration: Meanwhile, Apple's privacy marketing took a hit this year as checks went out for the ninety-five million dollar Lopez settlement, resolving claims that Siri recorded private conversations without user consent.
scenes.heading: Siri recorded private conversations without user consent and shared them with advertisers.

scenes.narration: John Ternus is abandoning old Apple isolationism to move quickly. By leaning on Google for cloud AI and LG for home security, Apple is trading exclusivity for raw speed.
scenes.heading: Trading Exclusivity for Speed
scenes.subheading: The new playbook under John Ternus

scenes.narration: If Apple cannot turn that speed into upgrades across Europe and China, that premium valuation will crack. Hit subscribe, and I will catch you in the next one.
scenes.broll_query: person walking away through modern city
scenes.heading: Subscribe for More Tech Deep Dives
